resources.string: Car, scooter, bike or EV. It takes a few seconds.
Log 2 full-tank fill-ups to unlock your real mileage
Mileage is measured tank-to-tank: fill to full, drive, fill to full again. Partial fills in between are counted.
Everything you spent on this vehicle this month (fuel, charging, service, tolls, parking and other running costs), divided by the kilometres driven this month.
Loan EMIs and the purchase price are left out, so the number shows what it costs to run the vehicle. You can change which categories count in Settings.
Your mileage dropped %1$d%% over the last 2 tanks. Check tyre pressure: it is the most common cause.
You have tracked 1,000 km on %1$s. Your averages are getting reliable.
10,000 km of %1$s, every fill-up accounted for.
A full year of fill-ups and costs. Your monthly and seasonal trends now mean something.
%1$s km/%2$s: your best full-to-full tank so far.
